response.sql: WITH all_races AS (SELECT DISTINCT raceId FROM constructorStandings), qualified AS (SELECT raceId, AVG(points) AS avg_points, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings WHERE points > 6.0 GROUP BY raceId), per_race AS (SELECT r.raceId, q.avg_points, q.avg_wins FROM all_races r LEFT JOIN qualified q ON q.raceId = r.raceId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg_wins FROM per_race) SELECT p.raceId, p.avg_points, p.avg_wins, p.avg_wins - o.overall_avg_wins AS wins_diff FROM per_race p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg_wins IS NOT NULL ORDER BY wins_diff IS NULL, wins_diff DESC LIMIT 10;
